Template shape: { id, type: poster | template | stream, label, kicker, title, body, buttons: [{ label, href, style }], media, mood, startsAt, endsAt, audience }. 'label' is the short segment name under each story bar. Slides outside startsAt/endsAt are skipped (at build and again in the browser). audience: all | visitor | signed-in. The stream slide's live-state wording lives in the Hero component; its offline title and countdown come from site.json nextStream.
